name: upup
description: UpUp (涨涨) — Chinese-language deep financial research AI agent. 中国版 Dexter：forked from virattt/dexter, 面向 A 股 / 港股 / 中文投研场景，扩展 50 个投资分析 skill、5 阶段 /invest 工作流、4 runtime 插件、EN+zh-CN i18n。

scripts.test:pi-contracts: bun test src/runtime/pi src/extensions/upup src/print.test.ts src/session/pi-migration.test.ts src/gateway/agent-runner.pi.test.ts src/cron/executor.pi.test.ts src/controllers/agent-runner.pi.test.ts && bun --cwd packages/pi-finance-sdk test
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun build --compile --target=bun --outfile=dist/upup src/index.tsx --external=playwright --external=playwright-core && rm -rf dist/pi-finance-sdk && mkdir -p dist/pi-finance-sdk && cp packages/pi-finance-sdk/package.json dist/pi-finance-sdk/package.json && cp -R packages/pi-finance-sdk/extensions packages/pi-finance-sdk/skills packages/pi-finance-sdk/prompts packages/pi-finance-sdk/workflows packages/pi-finance-sdk/policies packages/pi-finance-sdk/evals packages/pi-finance-sdk/src dist/pi-finance-sdk/ && chmod +x dist/upup && echo '✅ Build complete: dist/upup'
scripts.build:all: bun run build:types && bun run build:hooks && bun run build:memory && bun run build:plugin-sdk
scripts.build:types: cd packages/types && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun && npx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir dist
scripts.build:hooks: cd packages/hooks && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun && npx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir dist
scripts.build:bun: bun run typecheck && echo '✅ Bun build complete - run: bun start'
scripts.build:node: npx esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --target=node22 --platform=node --outfile=dist/index.js --external:better-sqlite3 --external:@duckdb/duckdb-wasm --external:playwright --external:playwright-core --external:dotenv --external:zod --external:@earendil-works/pi-tui --external:gray-matter --external:fs --external:path --external:os --external:crypto --external:stream --external:events --external:readline --external:tty --external:util --external:url --external:http --external:https --external:zlib --external:buffer --external:child_process --external:module --external:net --external:tls --external:dgram --external:dns --external:http2 --external:inspector --external:punycode --external:querystring --external:string_decoder --external:sys --external:timers --external:stream/promises --external:path/posix --external:path/win32 --alias:gray-matter=/tmp/shims/gray-matter.js --format=esm --inject:/tmp/node-shim.js --log-level=error && echo '✅ Node.js build complete: dist/index.js'
scripts.build:node:win: bun build src/index.tsx --target=node --outfile=dist/upup.exe --external=dotenv --external=zod && echo '✅ Windows build complete'
scripts.build:compile: bun build --compile --target=bun --outfile=upup src/index.tsx --external=playwright --external=playwright-core && rm -rf pi-finance-sdk && mkdir -p pi-finance-sdk && cp packages/pi-finance-sdk/package.json pi-finance-sdk/package.json && cp -R packages/pi-finance-sdk/extensions packages/pi-finance-sdk/skills packages/pi-finance-sdk/prompts packages/pi-finance-sdk/workflows packages/pi-finance-sdk/policies packages/pi-finance-sdk/evals packages/pi-finance-sdk/src pi-finance-sdk/ && chmod +x upup && echo '✅ Binary compile complete - run: ./upup'
scripts.build:compile:win: bun build --compile --target=bun --outfile=upup.exe src/index.tsx && rm -rf pi-finance-sdk && mkdir -p pi-finance-sdk && cp packages/pi-finance-sdk/package.json pi-finance-sdk/package.json && cp -R packages/pi-finance-sdk/extensions packages/pi-finance-sdk/skills packages/pi-finance-sdk/prompts packages/pi-finance-sdk/workflows packages/pi-finance-sdk/policies packages/pi-finance-sdk/evals packages/pi-finance-sdk/src pi-finance-sdk/ && echo '✅ Windows binary compile complete'

pkg.name: upup
pkg.description: UpUp - AI agent for deep financial research

author: UpUp Team
